query:
SELECT TOP 18
    pl_name,
    hostname,
    pl_rade,
    pl_bmasse,
    pl_orbper,
    pl_eqt,
    sy_vmag,
    st_teff,
    sy_dist,
    ra,
    dec,
    discoverymethod,
    disc_facility,
    tran_flag,
    pl_refname
FROM ps
WHERE pl_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pl_name
transformations: none — records written to CSV and JSON exactly as returned by the API
